result.note: Tests the Kishau dam agreement: number of signatory states, its place in the Centre's water-dispute settlements and the 90% central funding formula.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Kishau dam agreement signed in September 2026:
items: It was signed by six northern states.
It was the tenth water dispute the Centre has settled since 2018.
It used a formula under which the Centre funds 90% of a national project.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. Six northern states signed the long-stalled agreement, the tenth water dispute settled since 2018 under the Centre's 90% funding formula for national projects. The story notes that the generous formula also gives holdout states a reason to wait.
questions.source: Six northern states signed the decades-stalled Kishau dam agreement, the tenth water dispute the Centre has settled since 2018 using a formula where it funds 90% of a national project, which also gives holdout states a reason to wait.
